description: Returns the payment terms for https://horizonpulse.dev/api/tokenized-equity (base $0.005; USDC on Base only); this tool never runs the check or pays. Pay the 402 over HTTP with x402 v2: GET ?symbol=AAPLx or ?contract=0x9d275685dc284c8eb1c79f6aba7a63dc75ec890a (optional chain=ethereum|hyperevm). Onchain totalSupply only.. Onchain totalSupply for one seeded tokenized-stock entry by symbol or contract: issuer, underlying ticker, chain, contract, decimals, and the custodian named on the issuer page, with source URLs. Seed: Ondo, xStocks/Backed, Dinari. Supply is not a share count or a price. Unknown entry, bad input or RPC down: not charged. USDC on Base only.
